description: Coerce a victim and relay its NTLM to LDAP to write RBCD or shadow credentials.

telemetry.detail: Authentication coercion (PetitPotam MS-EFSR, PrinterBug MS-RPRN, DFSCoerce, etc.) generates distinctive RPC traffic to the victim.
Relayed NTLM authentication lands as a logon on the relay target.
Coercion-plus-relay chains are heavily signatured; NTLM relay is a well-known, widely detected pattern.
Directory write (msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity / KeyCredentialLink) via the relayed session, if DS-change auditing is on.

prerequisite_privilege: Network position to coerce and relay; LDAP signing not enforced
abuse_primitive: Coerce + ntlmrelayx -t ldap://dc --delegate-access (RBCD) or shadow creds.
notes: Requires LDAP signing/channel-binding to be unenforced. The follow-on directory write is the loud part where auditing is on.
